title: Community post (4 years ago, approx date)
summary: Celebrates winning a 5-month copyright fight: all blocked Grappler Baki videos and his Devon Larratt video restored, channel strike-free; thanks #ProtectYourCreators supporters.
claims: After 5 months of legal disputes, his Grappler Baki videos blocked by Japanese rights holders were restored
